controls: digest-verified catalog (tampered payload dropped at load; mismatch refused at install)
schema guard: depth/nodes/bytes/cycle bounds + object-root requirement
description size cap (payload-bomb descriptions rejected at discovery)
url policy: deny-by-default private/loopback/link-local — now also enforced for HOOK targets (creation + dispatch re-check)
deny-by-default grants, terminal admin-only revoke, cross-tenant no-oracle (404)
custom-tool wrappers narrow arguments; revoked servers fail closed (SERVER_DISABLED)
S2: team policy deny-wins enforced at calls, grant creation, and wrapper+source tools
S2: shared service never imports extension code (SDK local-hook boundary)
risks.remaining: No publisher signing/provenance beyond bundled digests; no external audit of curated payloads; live SDK-to-S5 confinement chain remains for S5 evidence.
